Her days involve lots of data analysis, stakeholder calls, and the occasional field investigation.

  • Provide your current payoff and regular balance

<action type="say">
Under this login, the system is only returning:
- Main Checking (****1234)
- Travel Rewards credit card (****8899)

No loan‑type account is being returned to me at all, so I do not have any way to query your auto loan balance from here. I can’t “force” a hidden account to appear—if it’s not in the account list the bank exposes to this assistant, I can’t see or access it.

To move this forward, there are a few likely reasons and concrete steps:

1) Check if the auto loan is actually visible in your app
- Log in to this same profile in the bank’s mobile app or website.
- Go to the full “Accounts” view and look for separate sections like “Loans,” “Auto Loans,” or “Installment Loans.”
- If you do see the auto loan there, note:
  • The loan nickname  
  • The last 4 of the loan number  
  • The current balance shown  
If you tell me those numbers, I can help you understand principal vs interest, payoff amount, etc.—but I still can’t pull them directly unless the loan appears in the system’s account list.

2) If you do NOT see the loan in the app either
Then it’s almost certainly a linking issue on the bank’s side. In that case, the right next step is:
- Contact the bank’s support (phone or in‑app chat).
- Tell them: “My auto loan should be under this online banking login, but it’s not showing. Please link it to this profile and tell me the current balance and payoff amount.”
- They can:
  • Confirm the account is active  
  • Link it to this username  
  • Provide your current balance and payoff quote  

3) If this is a joint loan, business loan, or recently refinanced
- Joint / business: it may be under the co‑borrower’s or business login instead of yours.
- Recently opened/refinanced (last few days): it might not be fully provisioned to online banking yet.

Because the tools I have cannot see any loan accounts under your current login, I cannot give you the exact current balance from here. Once you’ve either:
- Found it in your online banking view, or
- Received the balance/payoff info from support,

paste those details here and I’ll help you interpret them (how much is principal, how extra payments would affect term, what payoff by a certain date would take, etc.).</action>
